answer_1.quote: Previous efforts on metaphor generation demonstrate the task can bring benefits to a wide range of NLG downstream tasks.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Metrics We use perplexity (PPL) to evaluate the fluency of the generated text... Dist-1 and Dist-2 compute the distinct unigrams and bigrams ratio of generated text... To test the metaphoricity (Meta) of generated outputs, we train a RoBERTa-based Chinese metaphor classifier...

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation based on the following three criteria: 1) Fluency... 2) Consistency... 3) Creativity... Three annotators were instructed to rate the three criteria from 1 to 5...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated metaphor on fluency, consistency, and creativity using a scale from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
